Headline: Property management with a personal touch
Subheadline: Lee Newton Co. looks after rental homes in Baltimore: finding good residents, handling repairs and keeping owners informed.

Owner reporting | Regular updates on income, costs and condition.

For property owners | One local contact who looks after your property, your residents and your paperwork.
For residents | A responsive office for questions, repairs and renewals.
Know the neighborhood | Local experience with Baltimore rowhouses and rental homes.
Clear communication | Regular updates so nothing is a surprise.
